detailed_descriptions.en: The second part of the Lamborghini Dream Pack is here, introducing the Lamborghini Miura SV, the Diablo SV-R SuperTrofeo, the Murcielago R-GT & the Revuelto. Lamborghini Miura SV The Miura SV was the final and most refined evolution of what is considered to be the first true Supercar; Featuring improved handling, a more powerful 385 hp V12, and wider rear tires, the Miura SV was both beautiful & groundbreaking due to its mid-engine design. Lamborghini Diablo SV-R Super Trofeo A track-only version of the Diablo SV, the SV-R was Lamborghini’s first official race car and the first used for its one-make Super Trofeo series in 1996. Lamborghini Murciélago R-GT Developed in collaboration with Reiter Engineering and Audi Sport, the R-GT was a race-spec version of the Murciélago built for FIA GT and Le Mans. Lamborghini Revuelto The Revuelto is Lamborghini’s latest hypercar and its first HPEV; combining a new 6.5L naturally aspirated V12 with three electric motors, active rear wing, and dampers – all duly simulated in AMS2.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The second part of the Lamborghini Dream Pack is here, introducing the Lamborghini Miura SV, the Diablo SV-R SuperTrofeo, the Murcielago R-GT & the Revuelto.

Lamborghini Miura SV

The Miura SV was the final and most refined evolution of what is considered to be the first true Supercar; Featuring improved handling, a more powerful 385 hp V12, and wider rear tires, the Miura SV was both beautiful & groundbreaking due to its mid-engine design.

Lamborghini Diablo SV-R Super Trofeo

A track-only version of the Diablo SV, the SV-R was Lamborghini’s first official race car and the first used for its one-make Super Trofeo series in 1996.

Lamborghini Murciélago R-GT

Developed in collaboration with Reiter Engineering and Audi Sport, the R-GT was a race-spec version of the Murciélago built for FIA GT and Le Mans. 

Lamborghini Revuelto

The Revuelto is Lamborghini’s latest hypercar and its first HPEV; combining a new 6.5L naturally aspirated V12 with three electric motors, active rear wing, and dampers – all duly simulated in AMS2.
